200.description: Advisory simulation from current local read models.

advisory.description: Always true. The simulation reserves and moves nothing.

asOf.description: Oldest watermark among the facts the simulation used.

sites.description:
One advisory view per site, built from the local read models. This
endpoint does NOT propose transfers; proposals come from
POST /v1/transfer-proposals:generate over an explicit snapshot, and
an operator approves one with POST /v1/transfers:approve.

capacityOverWindow.description: Published capacity over the plan window.

capacityHeadroom.description: Capacity minus demand. Negative means the site is short.
